questions.q: Which Purview solution actually connects to data sources and scans them to build the technical metadata inventory?
options: Data Map
Data Catalog
Insider Risk Management
Data Loss Prevention
questions.explain: Data Map is the solution that connects to sources like Azure SQL, Data Lake, Snowflake, and Fabric, scans them, and builds the technical inventory of tables, columns, and classifications.

options: The modern, business-concept-driven experience inside Data Catalog, organized around governance domains, data products, and glossary terms
A separate Azure subscription used only for compliance data
A classic reporting tool unrelated to Data Map
A synonym for Microsoft Purview itself with no distinct meaning
questions.explain: Unified Catalog is the modern experience inside Data Catalog that wraps Data Map's raw technical inventory in business context — domains, data products, glossary terms, and OKRs.

questions.q: Per the lesson, how should you think about the relationship between Data Map and Data Catalog?
options: Data Map is the plumbing that scans sources; Data Catalog is the room people actually walk into to find and use data
They are two unrelated products with no shared data
Data Catalog scans sources and Data Map displays search results
Data Map only works with Power BI content
questions.explain: The lesson's analogy: Data Map does the unglamorous scanning work; Data Catalog is where a business user actually goes to answer whether needed data exists and can be used.

questions.q: On the Purview solutions page, which category is Data Catalog grouped under?
options: Data Governance
Risk & Compliance
Data Security
Core
questions.explain: The solutions page groups Data Catalog under "Data Governance," describing it as a searchable inventory of data assets and metadata you can find and curate.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT something Unified Catalog adds on top of Data Map's raw technical inventory, per the lesson?
options: Physical server hardware provisioning
Governance domains grouping data by business area
Data products and glossary terms giving curated meaning to assets
Lineage and estate-health insights
questions.explain: Unified Catalog adds business context — domains, data products, glossary terms, lineage, and insights — not infrastructure provisioning, which isn't a catalog concern at all.
